purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 105 hypothesis 2 after preserving and auditing the v89 failure.
change_scope: One generic context change: preserve a bounded source preview, path, size, line count, and truncation state after a successful file.read_text result, with generic guidance to inspect a distinct related module or edit instead of repeating the same read. No action, argument, path, or answer is selected for the model.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: v89 recovered the model's wrong path and the model explicitly read the real source at step 2. LiteAgent then compacted the successful result to downstream_context=null, so the next model request contained no source content. The model repeated the same read and search until the eight-event no-progress window stopped it after 45.659 Agent seconds. Evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Tests use an unrelated processor.py module and a large synthetic module. They prove the compact context preserves a short source exactly, bounds long content to 4200 JSON characters, distinguishes source truncation from context truncation, and gives only generic next-step guidance.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The Runner exposes truthful content already returned by the model-selected file.read_text call. It does not inspect another file, choose an edit, generate replacement text, rewrite arguments, or execute a follow-up action.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: unchanged public action selection and Top-K; no action or schema was added
implementation_evidence.ruff: all active source, scripts, and tests passed lint; changed files passed format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan and canonical links
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit the untouched baseline, classify the failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most three materially different generic hypotheses with one targeted A/B each. If all three fail, mark the task task_blocked and immediately advance to the next ledger entry.

selection.method: targeted A/B for the current first non-pass ledger task
